tap.source: Bi, Li, Zhai, FFitts law, CHI 2013, Table 5 (index-finger typing, We = sqrt(2*pi*e)*SDxy, mean of 9 digraph rows); per axis = SDxy/sqrt(2). Mean offsets 0: Azenkot & Zhai MobileHCI 2012 report vertical offsets of 2.16 px (two thumbs) and 4.69 px (one finger), well under 0.5 mm.

fitts.source: Least-squares fit of Shannon-form Fitts ID_n = log2(A/W+1), W=5 mm, to the 9 rows of FFitts Table 5 (mean times, ms).
